name: Broodlord
oracle_text:
Ravenous (This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it. If X is 5 or more, draw a card when it enters.)
Brood Telepathy — When this creature enters, distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of other target creatures you control.
blocked_sentences: Brood Telepathy — When this creature enters, distribute X +1/+1 counters among any number of other target creatures you control

needs.what: distribute_counters on a TRIGGERED ability (a self_enters trigger) with an X-sized amount ({"x": true}, the X paid for the permanent spell) among any number of other target creatures you control (target spec: up to X targets, controller you, exclude_self), the division chosen when the trigger is put on the stack
needs.why_existing_wont_do: distribute_counters exists, but the packet's notes restrict it to activated abilities with a printed amount ('Not available on spells or triggered abilities'); add_counters gives every target the same number, so it cannot divide X among them. Ravenous itself is expressible (x-sized enters counters plus a self_enters draw trigger with condition cmp >= {binding: x} 5, as on Jacked Rabbit); only this line is blocked
